newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom eases after ADS pricing.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom eases after ADS pricing.

text.p: Shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom were quoted lower in active trade on the Russian Trading System after details of the price of an international offering were announced.
Gazprom was quoted at $0.311 at 0850 GMT after closing on Friday at $0.330 in a flat market. Nearly 1.22 million shares were traded. The price had earlier briefly touched $0.365.

Morgan Stanley and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, lead managers of the offering, earlier said the preliminary price had been set at $14 to $16 per American Depositary Share, each representing 10 ordinary shares.
